questions.q: Whom does the Wisdom of Solomon first call to love righteousness?
questions.evidence: Love righteousness, you that be judges of the earth, Think you of the Lord with a good mind, And in singleness of heart seek you him

questions.q: By whose envy did death enter the world?
questions.evidence: But by the envy of the devil death entered into the world, And they that are of his portion make trial thereof

questions.q: "The souls of the righteous are in the hand of" whom?
questions.evidence: But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, And no torment shall touch them

questions.q: How did Solomon receive wisdom, Wisdom 7 says?
options: He learned it from his father
He found it in a scroll
He prayed and it was given
questions.evidence: For this cause I prayed, and understanding was given me: I called upon God, and there came to me a spirit of wisdom

questions.q: In Wisdom 10, through what did wisdom lead the righteous people?
questions.evidence: She brought them over the Red sea, And led them through much water

questions.q: What does God love, Wisdom 11 says?
questions.evidence: For you love all things that are, And abhor none of the things which you did make

questions.q: What food did God give his people, according to Wisdom 16?
questions.evidence: Instead whereof you gave your people angels’ food to eat

questions.q: What does Wisdom mock men for calling gods?
questions.evidence: Who called them gods which are works of men’s hands

questions.q: Whom does Solomon ask God to give him, she who sits by his throne?
questions.evidence: Give me wisdom, her that sits by you on your throne
